label: Favorite Toggle
title: Favorite Toggle
summary: Use a Favorite Toggle on an image card so people can save the item for later with one tap.
corePrinciple: One heart per item, on imagery, saying exactly what gets saved.

anatomy.title: A heart on glass
anatomy.description: A frosted circle holds a single heart icon. There is no visible label.
blocks: Frosted circle that keeps the heart readable over photos.
Filled heart; its colour is meant to change when saved.

configuration.title: Pick a size for the card
configuration.description: Size is the only visual choice. Medium matches the Figma component; use Small only on dense thumbnails and Large on hero images.
blocks: Fits tiny thumbnails but is hard to tap.

sizing.title: A fixed square set by the size mode
sizing.description: The toggle never stretches. On phones its tap area reaches 44 px around the circle; in a web browser only the visible circle responds, 14 px for Small and 29 px for Medium.

content.title: Name what gets saved
content.description: The toggle has no visible text. Give it an accessibility label that names the item, so screen reader users hear what they are saving.

inContext.description: The toggle sits in the top-right corner of the card image. The screen keeps the list of saved items and passes each card its saved state and change handler.

sources.title: Use the public Favorite Toggle contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Declared and installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 from the team’s private package repository. Size comes from the Favorite Toggle Size mode (S 14, M 29, L 41 px) and defaults to M, the Figma size. Saved uses the Favorite Toggle Color Active mode: a white circle with a gold heart. On the web the saved state is announced (aria-checked). On iOS and Android a hit slop extends the tap area to 44 px; react-native-web ignores it, so in a browser the tap area equals the visible size.
